term_create_02.spec: RDF 1.2 Concepts, section Literals (a literal has the datatype IRI rdf:dirLangString if and only if it has a language tag and a base direction)
term_create_02.note: Jena builds "abc"^^rdf:dirLangString with no language or direction; @factoidal/core refuses the term (term.invalid). term_create_01 (rdf:langString with no language) passes because the core DataFactory makes a plain string of it.
